notes.title: v1.03 update!
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hi everyone![/h3][/b]
Over the past week, we've tried to implement as many things as possible for the best feel of the game. We hope that this update will make your experience of the game better!

Big things:
[list]
[*] Added damage to monsters when kicking them
[img]https://i.ibb.co/TvRj60X/Kill-By-Foot.gif[/img]


[*] Fixed Berserk (big monster) getting stuck in passageways, now you can't hide from him there
[img]https://i.ibb.co/n76W6rh/Berserker.gif[/img]


[*] Added map for easy and normal difficulty
[img]https://i.ibb.co/kQwCwyM/Map.png[/img]

[*] Increased the distinction between difficulties and added a feature to enter your syd if you want to replay a level or speed through it
[img]https://i.ibb.co/YPDfLDp/New-Difficulty-Overlay.png[/img]


[*] Improved visibility of rooms with generators through floor markings
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Y3p7qSd/Marks-For-Generator-Room.png[/img]


[*] And added Steam achievements!
[img]https://i.ibb.co/ScXCGSz/Achievements.png[/img]
[/list]


Things are smaller:
[list]
[*] Added light indication for check panels in experiment rooms 
[*] Moved the toilet in the smallest corridor so that you won't get stuck in it
[*] Adjusted monster death animations
[*] Increase the frequency of background music playing and increase its default volume
[*] Corrected blackouts in some rooms
[*] Corrected colliders of some furniture
[*] Fixed a bug where you could use 1 item multiple times
[*] Fixed a bug where all NPCs were dead when loading a save
[/list]

Balance:
[list]
[*] Slightly reduced the total number of items dropped 
[*] Reduced the number of items dropped on Hard difficulty
[*] Revolver dropout increased slightly
[*] Reduced increase in hunger when running
[/list]


Well, good luck finding you a shotgun, and we'll go get some rest!

Regards, 
ValiantLight team

notes.title: Thank you and the announcement of the v1.03 update!
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hello everyone![/h3][/b]
With the release of Sporeborn Dark, we have gained a lot of valuable experience. It has not been an easy journey, the results of which we are now absorbing to become better! 
This has only been possible because of you, your support and feedback from you, for which thank you so much!
It's been an interesting few days since release, we've tried to release critical patches as quickly as possible that improve the game experience by fixing some unpleasant issues and adding features that we didn't have time to release in time for the release.

With this post, we - the ValiantLight team, wanted to thank you all once again and announce an update, in which we will also provide fixes for some unpleasant moments and add a few features. We are going to release this update at the end of this week, if all goes well :)

Here's a quick summary of what's coming:
[list]
[*] - Addition of a map whose mechanics will be different from the difficulty selected
[*] - Adding steam achievements to the game
[*] - Improving the balance of the game on different difficulties
[*] - Fixing Berserk (a big monster), his animations and his getting stuck in passages
[*] - Fixing several unpleasant bugs
[/list]

notes.title: v1.02 update
notes.content:
A feature that we didn't have time to add in time for release, but is now available:
You can now select the difficulty level when starting the map
It differs in the size of the map and accordingly the number of monsters, items and generators on it, as well as the number of inventory slots. 
We hope that the ability to choose the difficulty will improve your gaming experience!

notes.title: v1.01 here!
notes.content:
[b]Thanks for your feedback, we've made some hot fixes based on it. 
We also added a few things that didn't make it to the release.[/b]

So here's a short list of changes, just to keep you up to date:
[list]
[*] [b]Big load optimization[/b]
[*] Small optimization of in-game process
[*] Remove the movement after death of monsters
[*] Limit spawn notes that are not important to the plot
[*] Fix lighting in the passageways
[*] Correct the animation of death of the main character
[*] Correct ammo drop from broken weapons
[*] Corrected NPC animations
[*] Adjust the difficulty of a large monster
[/list]

notes.title: Sporeborn Dark is available now!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Sporeborn Dark has launched![/b][/h3]

We are thrilled to announce that *Sporeborn Dark* is now available!

For over a year, we have been working remotely to bring this game to life. This is our first project as a team, and we are incredibly proud of what we have achieved. It has been an exciting journey, and we are eager for you to experience *Sporeborn Dark*. 

If you want to support us, the best way is to play our game. And we hope you enjoy it as much as we enjoyed creating it!

Thank you for being with us,

ValiantLight.

notes.title: Release announcement!
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hey everyone![/h3][/b]
Yes, Sporeborn Dark is releasing on September 19!
Thank you for staying with us throughout this year of development.
We’re excited to share some of the latest updates and improvements we’ve made in Sporeborn Dark.

[b]Big changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Improved character and monster animations. Movements are now smoother and more realistic, enhancing the overall experience.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/mzn8VhL/GIF-03-09-2024-16-00-15.gif[/img]

[*] Added new rooms with visual storytelling elements. Items are arranged in a way that lets players imagine what happened there.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/HqPbvCt/2024-09-03-160955.png[/img]

[*] Additional entities have been added to enhance storytelling.
[/list]


[b]Polishing and Visual Enhancements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved visibility of crushable bodies.
[*] Added variety to crushed bodies for a more immersive environment.
[*] Detailed work on furniture placement.
[*] Enhanced shadows and light representation on objects.
[*] Adjustments to the game flow, including the beginning and ending sequences.
[*] Game menu redesign with additional windows to improve user experience.
[*] Fixed a bug related to save file deletion.
[*] Overall game balance and difficulty adjustments.
[/list]

We continue to polish and improve certain aspects of the game, and we're just a little bit away from [b]release![/b]

[b]Now is a great time to add Sporeborn Dark to your wishlist so you don't miss out on that day:[/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2601640/Sporeborn_Dark/

notes.title: Dev logs #16 - improvements, tweaking mechanics
notes.content:
[b][h3]Hey everyone![/h3][/b]

We've made several updates recently, which are detailed in the new Dev Logs #16. We improved character and monster animations, added new items, updated the sound, and made the text easier to read. In addition, the fear mechanic now makes firearm sights shake when a character is scared.

[list]
[*] Additional usable items were added to diversify existing ones.
[img]https://i.ibb.co/tLwzvFt/New-items.png[/img]

[*] Added new audio for additional storytelling.
[*] Improved experimental rooms.
[*] Worked on font improvements and readability.
[*] Enhanced fear mechanics. When the character is highly scared, the firearm's aim will shake now
[img]https://i.ibb.co/V9FqzqW/GIF-20-08-2024-19-58-34-1.gif[/img]

[*] Weapons can be reloaded by clicking on the inventory slot where the ammo is stored, in addition to using the reload button
[/list]

notes.title: Dev logs #15 - continued development of new presets and localization
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey Everyone![/b][/h3]
A lot of work has been done since the last dev log, and we're excited to share new updates in Dev log #15. We finalized our work with the save game data system, improved animations, and made several cool upgrades.

[b]Big changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] - Completed the penultimate set of new presets
[img]https://i.ibb.co/dWwMsXQ/New-Presets.png[/img]

[*] - Added broken furniture that blocks the way
[img]https://i.ibb.co/NxV79Z2/Debris.png[/img]


[*] - Completed the save game data system in the game, allowing you to keep your progress safe
[*] - Finished the technical work on localization, and we're now starting to translate Sporeborn Dark into different languages. For languages we are not familiar with, we are likely to use machine translation. But we are still thinking about it:)
[*] - Another round of balance work. We focused on increasing the variety of generated presets (rooms) and refining them to decrease dead ends, as well as adjusting the character's stamina
[*] - Modified the operation of electrical generators
[*] - Improved the starting room, including visual effects and exit conditions
[/list]

notes.title: Dev logs #14 - interface improvement, general polishing
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey Everyone![/b][/h3]
We're thrilled to share some exciting updates and improvements that we've made in Sporeborn Dark over the last few weeks. New dev log #14 focuses on improving the user interface, adding an in-game feedback form and adding a statistics screen upon completing the game as well.

[b]Big changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated user interface
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Bc4GbS3/12321131.png[/img]
[*] Added a dependency between stamina and hunger


[*] Added an in-game feedback form
[img]https://i.ibb.co/cxyQWZj/ss-c4c202ccf19b3dd2b5afa4108edd12c5fd09bbc7-1920x1080.png[/img]

[*] Added a statistics screen upon completing the game
[*] Performed visual polishing, level generation adjustments and tweaks to existing game objects

[/list]
[b]Smaller changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed issues of a persistent heartbeat after restarting the game
[*] fixed issues with a black screen and game crash when closing the elevator with a monster inside
[*] fixed issues with bullets hitting dead monster's corpses
[*] fixed incorrect sequence: death message followed by victory in an elevator
[*] fixed an issue where canceling the reload animation allowed aiming but didn’t stop the reload process
[/list]

notes.title: Dev logs #13 - development after the demo
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h3]
Since we dropped the demo for [b]Sporeborn Dark[/b], we’ve been hard at work preparing and polishing the game. New dev log #13 consists of a significant number of improvements and bug fixes, such as new textures, animations, balance tweaks and more.

[b]Big changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Added a bunch of new floor textures to make the levels look more interesting
[img]https://i.ibb.co/4Pp8jD3/image-2024-07-08-21-35-51.png[/img]

[*] Added a new monster: a spider that shoots tentacles
[img]https://i.ibb.co/zZ3568m/GIF-09-07-2024-15-09-04.gif[/img]

[*] Added shotgun animations
[*] Improved the reduction of visibility when fear increases
[*] Polished up some of the character and monster animations
[*] Improved the game’s balance
[/list]

[b]Smaller changes:[/b]
[list]
[*] fixed disappearing cursor when the monster kills the character
[*] fixed a bug with the game launch where sometimes the "Press any button" message didn’t appear, resulting in a black screen
[*] the spider now pushes furniture with less ease
[*] fixed monster revival issue after shotgun shot
[/list]

notes.title: Dev logs #12 - Improvements, optimization and polishing
notes.content:
[h2][b]Hi everyone![/b][/h2]
This post is more of a continuation of the previous post where we talk about the latest developments that we have managed to make.
Now we are mainly polishing the already made mechanics. 
In addition we are optimizing loading, generation and gameplay and although we are satisfied with the current state we hope that we will be able to optimize the game even better.

[h3][b]From the latest improvements:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/Cs7X45s/GIF-melee-Weapon.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Improved melee weapons[/b]
Added new weapon animations, now swinging sticks is more enjoyable

[img]https://i.ibb.co/Jcs5MYS/GIF-bloody-Furniture.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Improved generation and spawning of bloody furniture in the level[/b]
There's a lot more blood and bloody furniture now

[img]https://i.ibb.co/rZY06WK/GIF-highlighted-Items.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Improved item highlighting[/b]
It used to be that you couldn't see well, it was easy to miss an item
[/list]

[h3][b]Other:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] Now (finally) if a monster is behind a door - you hear it much worse than if it is in front of you
[*] Prepared key assignment window 
[*] Adjusting the balance of character parameters
[*] Adjusting the balance of item spawning
[*] Customizing level generation
[*] Polishing the start and end of the game
[*] Improved the VFX of weapons, and improved the recoil when using them
[*] Preparing for demo - polishing, bug fixes, repeat... and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again, and again
[/list]

notes.title: Dev logs #11 - We were silent, but we didn't sit idly by!
notes.content:
[h2][b]Greetings everyone![/b][/h2]

Well, we haven't posted any updates for over 2 months, but we haven't stopped the development of the project and now we are getting ready to release the demo version at the Steam Next Fest!

As you can see - we've updated the stime page, made a new trailer, uploaded actual screenshots and gifs, and updated the illustration! 


We have developed a lot of things in the project and now we will try to bring you up to speed:

[h3][b]From the new:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[img]https://i.ibb.co/MpjfDh4/SD-Monster-Anims.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Rendered and connected animations for the humanoid monster[/b]
Now it screams when it sees you and also hits you with its tentacles


[img]https://i.ibb.co/yXt3qmq/SD-note.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Added notes to help answer questions about what's going on[/b]
There are quite a few of them and we haven't decided exactly which ones to keep yet

[img]https://i.ibb.co/4pkzjhY/SD-ricochet.gif[/img]
[*] [b]Improving the aiming and adding a ricochet system[/b]
Now each bullet can ricochet off the wall and cause damage to you or the enemy, so be careful! 

[img]https://i.ibb.co/RvRhjT3/SD-generator.gif[/img]
[*] [b]A generator to turn on the lights around[/b]
Turning on the generator will make it a little more comfortable to be in the nearby space, unless of course you consider that this place is filled with monsters
[/list]


[h3][b]Also:[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] There is now an animation and a small delay mechanic when interacting with something
[*] Edits on the behavior of AI monsters
[*] Small edits on loading screens
[*] General improvement of visuals, adding details and color correction
[*] Added small hints at the beginning of the game
[*] Adjusted some sounds and added many new ones
[/list]

It's a far cry from everything we've done, but it takes time to shape it so it looks good
We will share further updates with you soon!
On top of that we're preparing for a demo, so a lot of time is spent testing and polishing, but we're trying to do as much as possible

Thank you for sticking with us and thanks for reading!
